title: Old Bear Battles
description: A lightweight, mobile-friendly virtual tabletop for hosting tabletop roleplaying sessions without mandatory sign-ins.
features: Canvas-based tactical map with pan, zoom, grids, fog of war, pointers, markers, and movement measurement
WebSocket room synchronization with WebRTC voice communication and server relay support
Browser-local storage for maps, tokens, audio, character sheets, and session backups
Token ownership, health bars, status conditions, movement speed tracking, and initiative management
Dice rolling with advantage and disadvantage support
D&D Beyond public character sheet integration
GM soundboard with synthesized effects and uploaded audio tracks
